integrity: The Hom-Lie-Yamaguti identities and the full s-Rota-Baxter defects are reconstructed symbolically. Finite-field enumeration is replay evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The identity-twist boundary k=1 is excluded because it is the distinct ordinary Lie-Yamaguti Rota-Baxter problem.
The theorem treats one explicit two-dimensional Hom-Lie-Yamaguti family.
The characteristic assumptions of the source, char K not equal to 2 or 3, are retained.
title: A singular-twist jump in Hom–Lie–Yamaguti s-Rota–Baxter operators
